insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: Now the summary gives them the vehicle, the loss date, the police report number, all of it in one block, so callbacks are happening the same day instead of the next morning.

insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: We added a new picklist value to the Claim Stage field in Salesforce, something our underwriting team asked for, and now the call records from Invoca aren't writing to our custom objects at all.
